sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Removes 20 Cost.
Cost removal effect boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces healing received by 100% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies a Greater Counter Heal that restores 10% HP when attacked for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Fortify 25% for 120 seconds (when physical or magic damage exceeds a percentage of max HP equal to this effect's value, the total damage is instead converted into fixed damage equal to the same percentage of max HP. This effect reduces by 10 seconds each time it is triggered).
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
